verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no capability for importing subscriptions from a spreadsheet or competing platform, and none for PCI-compliant card data transfer during migration. Adjacent items do not qualify: hosted pages for PCI collection, the export API (which moves data out, not in), and the generic REST API with idempotency keys are building blocks only.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can migrate live subscriptions in from a spreadsheet or a competing platform — including PCI-compliant card data transfer — without customers noticing
